# 1. FLANKER
## Libraries
```{r}
install.packages("schoRsch")
install.packages("readxl")
install.packages("ez")
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(ez)
library(schoRsch)
```

## Instructions - all commented
```{r}
# Instructions for data
# This spreadsheet contains the 2x2-AFC flanker data with SOA manipulation.  
# The first column includes participants' number.
# The second column is the trial number in the experiment. 
# The third column represents the orientation of the target arrow shown in a particular trial, where 1 for left, 2 for right, 3 for upward and 4 for downward. 
# The forth column shows the orientation of the flanker arrows in the same notion as the third column. 
# The fifth column reveals the RT of the trial in milliseconds. whether the trial is correct or not, where 1 is correct, and 0 means incorrect. 
# The sixth column shows whether the trial is correct or not, where 1 is correct, and 0 means incorrect.  the congreuncy condition of the trial, where 1 for congruent and 0 for incongruent.
# The seventh column shows the congreuncy condition of the trial, where 1 for congruent and 0 for incongruent. 
# The final column records the SOA levels, including -100, 0, 50, 100. Note hat the sign of the SOA in the this spreadsheet is opposite to what we define in the manuscript. 
```


## Reading data 

```{r}
rm(list = ls())
which_dat = "data/FlankerSOA-repl.xlsx"
data = readxl::read_excel(which_dat)
```

## pre_processing
```{r}
raw_data <- data %>% 
  mutate(prev_Congruency = dplyr::lag(data$Congruency), 
         prev_Accuracy = dplyr::lag(data$Accuracy))

processed_data = raw_data[raw_data$RT >= 200 & raw_data$RT <= 1500,]
processed_data = processed_data[!(processed_data$`Trial Number` %in% c(1, 121, 241, 361, 481, 601, 721, 841)),]
processed_data = processed_data[processed_data$Accuracy == 1 & processed_data$prev_Accuracy == 1,]
```

## function for the mean RTs across conditions
```{r}
cell_means <- function(data, ...) {
  data %>%
    group_by(Participant, ...) %>%
    summarise(rt = mean(RT), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(...) %>%
    summarise(M = mean(rt), SD = sd(rt), .groups = "drop")
}

# SOA
cell_means(processed_data, SOA)

# current cong
cell_means(processed_data, Congruency)

# previous cong
cell_means(processed_data, prev_Congruency)

# previous x current cong
cell_means(processed_data, prev_Congruency, Congruency)
```


## ANOVA
```{r}
processed_data$Participant = as.factor(processed_data$Participant)
processed_data$Congruency = as.factor(processed_data$Congruency)
processed_data$prev_Congruency = as.factor(processed_data$prev_Congruency)
processed_data$SOA = as.factor(processed_data$SOA)

aov.rt = ezANOVA(processed_data,
                 dv = RT,
                 wid = Participant,
                 within = .(Congruency, prev_Congruency, SOA),
                 detailed = TRUE,
                 return_aov = TRUE)
anova_out(aov.rt)

write.csv(processed_data, file = "processed_flanker.csv")
```


## Post-hoc analyses
```{r}
library(broom)
k_data <- subset(processed_data, SOA == -50)
aov.k = ezANOVA(k_data,dv = RT,
                wid = Participant,
                within = .(prev_Congruency, Congruency),
                detailed = TRUE,
                return_aov = TRUE)
anova_out(aov.k)
```

## Plots: 
```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# cse summarise function
summarise_se <- function(data, value, ...) {
  data %>%
    group_by(...) %>%
    summarise(M  = mean({{ value }}),
              SE = sd({{ value }}) / sqrt(n()),
              .groups = "drop")
}

# CE by SOA plot
ce_subj <- processed_data %>%
  group_by(Participant, SOA, Congruency) %>%
  summarise(rt = mean(RT), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Congruency, values_from = rt, names_prefix = "c") %>%
  mutate(CE = c0 - c1)                                   # incongruent - congruent

ce_sum <- summarise_se(ce_subj, CE, SOA)

ce_by_soa <- ggplot(ce_sum, aes(x = factor(SOA), y = M, group = 1)) +
  geom_line(linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = M - SE, ymax = M + SE), width = 0.08) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, fill = "white", size = 3, stroke = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 120), breaks = seq(0, 120, 20)) +
  labs(x = "SOA (ms)",
       y = "Congruency Effect (ms)\n(Incongruent RT - congruent RT)") +
  theme_classic()
ggsave(plot = ce_by_soa, "ce_by_soa.png")

# CE by SOA and prev cong
ce_prev_subj <- processed_data %>%
  mutate(prev = factor(prev_Congruency, levels = c(1, 0),
                       labels = c("prev cong", "prev incong"))) %>%
  group_by(Participant, SOA, prev, Congruency) %>%
  summarise(rt = mean(RT), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Congruency, values_from = rt, names_prefix = "c") %>%
  mutate(CE = c0 - c1)

ce_prev_sum <- summarise_se(ce_prev_subj, CE, SOA, prev)

ce_prev_soa <- ggplot(ce_prev_sum, aes(x = factor(SOA), y = M, colour = prev, group = prev)) +
  geom_line(linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = M - SE, ymax = M + SE), width = 0.08) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, fill = "white", size = 3, stroke = 1) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("prev cong" = "#8CC63F", "prev incong" = "#6A3D9A")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 120), breaks = seq(0, 120, 20)) +
  labs(x = "SOA (ms)",
       y = "Congruency Effect (ms)\n(Incongruent RT - congruent RT)",
       colour = NULL) +
  theme_classic()
ggsave(plot = ce_prev_soa, "ce_prev_soa.png")


# CSE by SOA
cse_subj <- ce_prev_subj %>%
  select(Participant, SOA, prev, CE) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = prev, values_from = CE) %>%
  mutate(CSE = `prev cong` - `prev incong`) 

cse_sum <- summarise_se(cse_subj, CSE, SOA)

cse_by_soa <- ggplot(cse_sum, aes(x = factor(SOA), y = M)) +
  geom_col(fill = "black", width = 0.3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = M - SE, ymax = M + SE), width = 0.08) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey70") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-20, 20), breaks = seq(-20, 20, 5)) +
  labs(x = "SOA (ms)", y = "CSE (ms)") +
  theme_classic()
ggsave(plot = cse_by_soa, "cse_by_soa.png")
```


## Mean error rates for experimental conditions
```{r}
rm(list = ls())
data = read_excel("FlankerSOA-repl.xlsx")
names(data)[2] = "TrialNum"
```

## calculate variables
```{r}
data$n1Accuracy = lag(data$Accuracy, 1)
data$n1Congruen = lag(data$Congruency, 1)
data$n1ArrowNum = lag(data$ArrowNum, 1)
firsttrials = c(0:7)*120+1
```

## exclude trials
```{r}
fdata = data %>%
  filter(!(TrialNum%in%firsttrials), RT >= 200, RT <= 1500)

gdata <- data.frame(Congruency=fdata$Congruency, 
                    n1Congruency=fdata$n1Congruency,
                    SOA=fdata$SOA,
                    Accuracy=fdata$Accuracy)

gdata %>% group_by(Congruency,n1Congruency,SOA) %>% summarise (x = mean(Accuracy))
```
